guard: an agent file whose subscribe names a pattern wider than every allowSubscribe entry is refused at load (#5404)
why: The suite drives cotal persona create --file in a sandboxed root, so the refusal comes from the shipped loader.
A1 checks a subscribe pattern by matching, so perm.> passes under perm.*, as cotal_join refused it already.
The command builds the cotal-ai closure, core included, so A1's afterRestore rebuilds it, leaving no dist/ compiled from the mutant.

mutations.name: A1 a subscribe pattern is checked by matching
mutations.expectRed: a --file with a family wider than every read entry is SCHEMA_INVALID naming the file and the reason
mutations.cell: a --file with a family wider than every read entry is SCHEMA_INVALID naming the file and the reason
mutations.note: An agent file could then ask for a family its credential can never read in full.
